reviewer: Codex light producer: manual actual GLB comparison

views.name: hull_rig
findings: The three-mast silhouette, square fore/main tiers, small triangular mizzen and raised after deck remain distinct in the actual GLB view; hull grain and the main rig lines are visible.
The side guns, carriage silhouettes, chainplate/deadeye rows and bow anchor gear remain present; this whole-vessel framing does not establish small distant tackle detail.
views.scope: Whole actual GLB with all visible hull, rig and sails.

views.name: deck_closeup
findings: At the matched 4.5 m deck field, directional grain, staggered plank ends, substantial hatch coaming, actual descending treads and rope handrails are clearly readable.
The nearby cannon bodies now shade as rounded surfaces rather than rectangular facets; wheeled timber carriages, trunnions and the capstan remain visible, while iron patina still repeats.
views.scope: Actual deck and fitting close-up at a fixed 4.5 metre physical field; rig hidden for visibility.

views.name: hold_interior
findings: The intact hold clearly shows individual sole planks, curved frames, stringers, repeated overhead beams/knees and a real framed mast step, substantially richer than the plain old Brig hold reference.
A glass-sided lantern sits on a diagonally braced provisions box at left, another box is partly visible at right, and a real stair remains in the darker background; the near room is unobstructed.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: hold_cutaway
findings: The declared cutaway exposes the continuous framed hold, planked sole, central mast support and connecting hatch stairs in the unchanged delivered GLB.
The broad structural framing also shows gun carriage rows and working-deck fittings above; small hardware and distant texture detail are not judged from this overview.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.

views.name: cabin_interior
findings: The intact cabin has clear plank grain and seams, a framed chart table with paper, timber legs, hull-side frames/knees and a glass lantern; these surfaces are more detailed than the smooth old Brig cabin reference.
The mast bears on its actual framed sole, and the real forward doorway and descending companion are visible behind it; this camera does not include every bed/bench/locker component.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: cabin_cutaway
findings: The after-room cutaway exposes the framed white-topped berth, chart table, bench and small stern locker through the retained curved frames and longitudinal timbers.
Mast support, stair/upper-deck relationships and the actual narrowing cabin sole remain visible; framing obscures some furniture portions, so this is supplementary structural evidence.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.

limitations: Static geometry and PBR inspection only; gameplay controllers and historical exactness are not certified.
The frozen renderer uses disclosed auxiliary lights. Intact hold/cabin images retain all room geometry; cutaway images list their temporary hidden meshes and remain supplements.
Whole-vessel and broad cutaway images do not establish readability of distant small hardware; near construction and surface finish are judged in the actual closeups.
Barrel curvature is corrected while the unchanged iron patina/reflection pattern remains visibly periodic; photorealistic metal is not claimed.
The intact cabin framing excludes some bed/bench/locker components; the separate cutaway and actual inventory supply complementary evidence.
One palette supplies natural-material/interior evidence; both final paint heroes and packed-source/export controls are renewed by the full audit.
instructions: Inspect every listed actual image and the matched old Brig reference views. Add at least two concrete observations per view. Set decision PASS only after inspection. A cutaway remains supplementary to the separate intact interior view.
